text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: elevated runtime queueing on runtime-prod-usw2 for model rdx/gpt-small (inflight > 95th percentile). Auto-alerting oncall.

clare: seeing big queue pileups and rising 5xxs on /v1/chat/generate. Page went out. Anyone oncall?

mike: on it, joining. grabbing charts now — looks like in-flight jumped from ~40 -> ~170 in the last 3m.

sophia: customer-facing: 2 enterprise customers reported timeouts and degraded latency on embeddings + chat. They hit a burst this morning.

ryan: quick question: is this single model or cross-model?

mike: mostly rdx/gpt-small, embeddings route has the worst tail. Possibly a job spike.

jessica: logs show lots of queued requests with TTL expiry: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:15:02Z] pid=2021 level=warn queue_wait_ms=12450 inflight=172 route=/v1/embeddings/model:rdx/gpt-small
[2026-03-17T10:15:05Z] pid=2021 level=error request_timeout_ms=30000 route=/v1/chat/generate status=504
```

oncall-sre: root cause hypotheses: sudden traffic burst + prefix cache miss causing long decode times, plus our max_inflight per-worker is too low for embeddings parallelism.

mike: mitigation proposals (pref / quick order):
1) temporarily increase global max_inflight for rdx/gpt-small in us-west-2 from 50 -> 120 (scale workers will respect).
2) enable soft-shedding for low-priority routes (free-tier and telemetry) to free slots.
3) reduce default per-request timeout from 30s -> 20s for chat to failfast and avoid long tails.
4) raise per-customer rate-limits for affected paid customers to allow quota bypass? (no — don't do unless approved)

clare: +1 to (1),(2),(3). (4) sounds risky. We need customer comms before any quota exceptions.

ryan: how to apply (1) quickly?

mike: patched via runtime admin API, example: 
```
curl -X POST https://runtime-admin.usw2.redwood-internal/api/v1/instances/rdx-gpt-small/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"max_inflight":120, "soft_shed_enabled":true}'
```
I'll run that now in maintenance window.

jessica: deploying change to runtime-prod-usw2 now (will target the model variant). Rolling update across 6 pods, 10s stagger.

oncall-sre: also enabling shedding rules: drop priority=low at 95th queue percentile and enforce immediate 429 for telemetry ingesters.

sophia: opening a short customer status note: "We’re applying mitigations to reduce timeouts and will monitor. ETA 10–15m." Shall I send?

clare: yes, send. Include link to status page and mention we’re escalating with a fix in progress.

mike: change applied. Observability: inflight dropped to ~70 within 60s and 5xxs decreased. CPU on workers increased but within headroom.

jessica: shedding rules active. Telemetry ingesters showing 429 spikes as expected.

oncall-sre: monitoring for 15m. Recommend keeping reduced chat timeout for 1h and followup with a config rollback plan.

ryan: creating followup ticket to investigate root cause: workload pattern, prefix cache miss rates, and whether autoscaler thresholds need tuning.

clare: noted — thanks team. Paging oncall remains until metrics stable for 30m.

sophia: customers updated, one asked for ETA on SLA credits — will route to CS.

mike: metrics holding, queuing normalizing. I'll keep the max_inflight at 120 for 45m then step down to 60 in 15m if stable.

clare: :thumbsup: good work. Closing page once stable for 30m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT note appended: mitigations applied: increased max_inflight, enabled soft-shed, reduced chat timeout. Trigger cleared pending verification.
